question: As per the Regulating Act of 1773, where was the first Supreme Court as a Court of Record established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Calcutta__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Supreme Court at Calcutta was established on 22 October 1774 by the Regulating Act of 1773.
 
• The drawback of this act was that the powers of the SC were not clearly defined.</l
